former.selection_rule: Maximum validation interval-censored log-likelihood; prefer eight inputs within tolerance. Horizons shown only if validation Brier beats a no-input baseline. Final refit on all non-test people; calibration shift from out-of-fold predictions; test evaluated once after all decisions.
former.censoring_assumption: Interval-censored likelihood assumes loss to follow-up is noninformative given the model inputs. IPCW evaluation weights by baseline-wave-stratified Kaplan-Meier loss curves, treating returns whose interval straddles the horizon as unresolved.
former.calibration_method: One log-hazard shift fitted by maximum likelihood on 5-fold out-of-fold predictions over all non-test participants, on top of a flexible piecewise baseline hazard.
